/treatment-questions: After speaking with the center, ask yourself: Did I feel informed or pressured?
Do their values align with ours?
Would I trust them with someone I love?
/talking-about-treatment: What have you seen with your own eyes that you will name in this conversation, as facts and not judgments?
If they choose not to pursue treatment, what will change? Can you say it calmly and briefly?
What will help you stop talking once you've said it, and not soften the boundary afterwards?
/legal-issues-guide: Where have you stepped between your loved one and a legal consequence, and what did it cost you?
What are you personally exposed to right now (co-signed leases or loans, the car, who lives in your house)?
Who could advise you before you make the next legal or money decision?
/treatment-modalities: What has been recommended for your loved one, and what problem is it meant to treat?
What are you expecting therapy to do that only structure and boundaries can do?
What will you ask the treatment team about what happens if this doesn't work?
/non-twelve-step-modalities: What in their plan provides daily accountability, connection, and meaning?
What are you afraid will happen if they choose a path other than the 12 Steps?
What behavior, not words, would tell you their plan is working?
/boundaries-ultimatums: Where do we collapse boundaries emotionally?
What consequence are we afraid to allow?
Are we asking for change—or planning for reality?
What would consistency look like for 30 days?
/no-negotiation: What deal or compromise have you made more than once, and what happened to it?
What is one thing you want to decide now, while it's calm, so you don't have to decide it in the next crisis?
Who or what outside the family could hold some of the structure, so you aren't the enforcer?
/boundary-drift: Where have our boundaries softened over time?
What emotion tends to trigger exceptions?
What consequence have we delayed or avoided?
Where are we more exhausted than intentional?
What boundary needs to be reset right now?
/anger-and-boundaries: What boundary do I only hold when I'm angry?
What happens to that boundary when I calm down?
What fear or guilt surfaces when anger fades?
What would it look like to hold this boundary calmly?
/what-changes-when-families-change: What are we currently doing that keeps the system stuck?
What would change if we stopped absorbing consequences?
Where are we confusing love with rescue?
What would family health look like—regardless of outcome?
What do we need to protect now?
/living-well-regardless: What have we put on hold waiting for change?
What does "living well" mean for us right now—not someday?
What guilt do we need to question?
What would stability look like regardless of outcome?
What is one small step toward reclaiming life this month?
/grief-for-family: What family did I imagine we would be?
What am I grieving that I've never named?
Where have I been holding my breath, waiting?
What kind of life can I build today, regardless of outcome?
/safe-to-open-up: What behaviors make me feel safer—not more hopeful?
What happens in my body when I imagine opening up?
Where have I overridden my instincts before?
What pace protects me right now?
What would self-respect look like in this season?
